WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT sc.School, sc.County, sc.Virtual,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY sc.County
           ORDER BY sa.AvgScrRead DESC
         ) AS rn
  FROM schools AS sc
  JOIN satscores AS sa
    ON ltrim(sc.CDSCode, '0') = ltrim(sa.cds, '0')
  WHERE sa.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT School
FROM ranked
WHERE Virtual = 'F'
  AND rn <= 5;

FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS c ON c.CDSCode = s.cds

ORDER BY s.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 5
